text: There are three bears who live together in a house in the woods.
They are the Great Big Bear, the Middle-sized Bear, and the Little Wee Bear.
They each have a bowl for their porridge: one big bowl, one medium bowl, and one small bowl.
They also have a chair to sit in and a bed to sleep in.
Each chair and bed is just the right size for each bear.
One day, the bears make porridge for breakfast. The porridge is very hot.

choices.text: The bears should eat it anyway because they are very hungry.
The bears throw away the porridge because they cannot eat it anymore.
The bears should wait for the porridge to cool down.

text: The porridge is way too hot and the bears burn their tongues.

text: After throwing away the food, the bears are left without anything to eat.

choices.text: The bears should eat it anyway because they are very hungry.

text: The bears wait for the porridge to cool down, which is a good habit to follow - waiting for things to cool down when they're too hot!
The bears decide to go outside to enjoy the fresh air while the porridge cools.
While they are out, a little girl named Goldilocks walks by.
She sees the bears' house and is curious.
She decides to take a look inside and doesn't wait for permission to enter the house.
She goes in and sees the porridge on the table.
Goldilocks feels full after eating the porridge, but now she needs to decide what to do next.
She is tired from walking to the bears' house.

choices.text: She should sit down to rest for a bit.
She should eat more porridge.
She should ignore that she is tired and go for a walk.

text: Goldilocks eats another bowl quickly, but realizes after she ate way too much! Her stomach starts to hurt.

choices.text: She should sit down to rest for a bit.

text: Resting after eating a big meal is very important, so you don't hurt your stomach.
Goldilocks first tries the Great Big Bear's chair, but it is too hard.
Then she tries the Middle-sized Bear's chair, but it is too soft.
Finally, she tries the Little Wee Bear's chair, and it is just right.
But when she sits down, the chair breaks! Oh no!
When the Three Bears come home, they see that their porridge was eaten, their chairs are out of place, the Little Wee Bear's chair is broken, and that there is a girl in their house.
They are very upset.

choices.text: Goldilocks should run away.
Goldilocks should say that they should have gotten a better chair.
Goldilocks should apologize for breaking into their house and breaking their chair.

text: She runs off and the bears become very sad that their food was eaten, and one of their chairs was broken!

text: The bears become very sad that she would say that, when she was the one who broke the chair!

text: Realizing she had made a mistake, she says, "I'm really sorry for coming into your house and eating your porridge and breaking your chair. I should have asked."
The bears look at Goldilocks and see that she is sorry.
The Great Big Bear, the Middle-sized Bear, and the Little Wee Bear all smile and say, "It's okay. You made a mistake, but you said sorry. We all make mistakes sometimes."
Goldilocks feels much better after apologizing.
The bears invite her to stay for a special breakfast. This time, they all shared their porridge together - each one eating from the bowl that was just right for them.
From that day on, Goldilocks remembers to ask before using other people's things, and she learns the importance of saying sorry when something goes wrong.
Goldilocks ignores that she is tired and goes for a walk.
Walking not only makes Goldilocks more tired, but makes her stomach hurt since she didn't rest after eating.
